import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (2 duplicates on penguin_id)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Ensure flipper length is numeric (some values may be stored as text)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix numbers written as text in body_mass_g (e.g. '3,600')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Normalize island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Dram': 'Dream', 'Torgerson': 'Torgersen'})
    # Normalize sex label variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df.loc[df['sex'].isin(['nan', 'none', '']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    g = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items()}
